description: Natural-number subtraction truncates, so the formal claim is true where the source claim about integers is false.

files.Main.lean:
/-- Source: for integers a < b, a - b < 0. -/
theorem sub_neg_nat (a b : Nat) (h : a < b) : a - b = 0 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le h.le

why: A correct gate rejects it because the formal statement no longer says what the source says (integers became naturals).
